verdict.rationale: A live, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec is confirmed at https://supermemory.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, bearerAuth scheme), backed by an API reference doc page and official TS/Python clients built on it. Missing for 10: no independent third-party corroboration beyond the hands-on probe, and the docs-subdomain openapi paths 404'd before the correct root-domain path was found.
